title: Basically no one is using AI agents for their DoorDash orders
gist: On DoorDash's Q3 2026 earnings call, CEO Tony Xu said outside AI agents have generated only several hundred orders in total, against nearly 1 billion orders in the quarter, calling it a "very low use case." DoorDash's MCP connector is under a month old and limited to beta partners, while its own Ask DoorDash feature reportedly lifts basket value nearly 50%.

themes.theme: Third-party AI agent ordering is negligible

insights.claim: DoorDash CEO Tony Xu said outside AI agents have generated only several hundred orders since launch, a very low use case for a company that handled just shy of 1 billion orders in Q3 2026.
insights.speaker: Kyle Orland
insights.so_what: Agentic commerce adoption in everyday consumer purchases is still essentially zero.
